
---

**Install / 安装:** Android 11+. On Android 13+, if the accessibility switch is greyed out ("Restricted setting"): Settings > Apps > Artemis On-Device > ⋮ > **Allow restricted settings**. / Android 13 及以上如果无障碍开关是灰的（「受限设置」）：设置 > 应用 > Artemis On-Device > ⋮ > **允许受限设置**。
